test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

I wish I __have__ a motorbike, I can't depend on the bus to reach my office on time.
solution:
The correct answer is '**had**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, '**had**' should be used instead of '**have**'.
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is: **wish + past simple **is used to express that we want a situation in the present (or future) to be different. 
 
 
• *Example: I wish I **spoke** Italian. ( I don't speak Italian)*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I wish I **had** a motorbike, I can't depend on the bus to reach my office on time.*
